title: Portable GitHub profile envelope configuration
description: Portable configuration contract for a GitHub profile envelope renderer. Publication and donor-specific rendering remain separate concerns.

theme.description: Named presentation/theme policy. Keep the public set bounded rather than accepting arbitrary renderer code.

background.description: Controls only the envelope-owned outer surface. Mounted-source backgrounds are configured separately.

text.description: safe = deterministic essential visible text; native = host-font-dependent SVG text permitted; minimal = essential fixed text only plus accessibility metadata.

motion.description: High-level motion choice only. Reduced-motion/static fallback remains mandatory when motion is enabled.

mounted_source_background.description: inherit removes only a known presentation background so mounted authoritative marks use the envelope surface; preserve leaves the source surface intact.

density.description: Presentation-only label density. It must never remove semantic repositories/data from the authoritative source model.

mode.description: GitHub adapter may pack adjacent logical windows into taller physical SVGs without changing logical global coordinates.
Do not copy third-party media into generated repository-owned SVG bytes unless a separate provenance/license decision permits it.
